definitions.gloss: this paper; this article; the present paper
definitions.explanation: The paper or article the writer is writing, used in academic and formal writing to refer to the text itself, much like English 'this paper' or 'the present article'.

examples.japanese: {本稿|ほんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: I state the aim of this paper.

examples.japanese: {本稿|ほんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: This paper deals with three problems.

examples.japanese: {本稿|ほんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{用|もち}いた→用いる：02314_mochiiru⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2025⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧もの⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The data used in this paper come from a 2025 survey.

notes:
A written word for academic papers, reports and essays; it is not used in speech. Typical in the opening and closing paragraphs: {本稿|ほんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{論|ろん}じる→論じる：02332_ronjiru⟧ (this paper discusses ...).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本書|ほんしょ}→本書：33652_honsho⟧: this book
- {拙稿|せっこう}: my (humble) paper, used of one's own work
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧: paper, thesis; the general word
